metadata.title: fix: hide mutation buttons and mask secrets for non-owners
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- **Mask tool headers** for non-owners across all `ToolRead` API responses (`GET /tools/{id}`, `GET /tools`, `GET /servers/{id}/tools`, admin endpoints) — header keys preserved, values replaced with masked placeholder
- **Mask sensitive `oauth_config` keys** (`client_secret`, `password`, `refresh_token`, etc.) in `GatewayRead.masked()` and `A2AAgentRead.masked()`
- **Gate Edit/Delete/Activate/Deactivate buttons** behind `{% if can_modify %}` in all 7 HTMX partial templates (servers, tools, resources, prompts, gateways, A2A agents, toolops)
- **Pass user context** (`current_user_email`, `is_admin`, `user_team_roles`) to all partial endpoint template contexts
- View and Test buttons remain visible to all users (read-only operations)

### Ownership resolution for `can_modify`

Access granted if ANY of:
1. Platform admin (`is_admin`)
2. Direct owner (`ownerEmail == current_user_email`)
3. Team owner (`user_team_roles[teamId] == 'owner'`)

### Files changed

| Area | Files |
|------|-------|
| Secret masking | `schemas.py`, `services/tool_service.py` |
| Context wiring | `main.py` (5 endpoints), `admin.py` (9 endpoints + helper) |
| Template gating | 7 `*_partial.html` templates |
| Test fixes | `test_tool_service.py`, `test_admin_apis.py` |

Closes #2760

reviews.author: brian-hussey
reviews.body:
Approved.
Tested locally, functionally correct but had to manually revoke is_admin on specific users after they had the admin role already.
If they had is_admin then there was no difference (users could see all administrative functions (i.e. delete + others)).

Coverage failure needs to be addressed, and the flake8 problem seems to be github having server errors at the moment, restarted - now it's failing at different place. locally flake8 passes, suggest restart when github is good again.
